tools.name: dataset_columns
tools.description: The columns, which of them are numeric, the row count and the provenance banner of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset. Call this first to learn the schema.

tools.name: dataset_search
tools.description: Rows of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset whose cells contain the query (case-insensitive), up to 50.

tools.name: dataset_row
tools.description: The rows of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset where a column equals a value exactly (case-insensitive).

tools.name: dataset_compare
tools.description: The rows of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset whose column is any of the given values, in the order given — for "X vs Y" questions.

tools.name: dataset_stats
tools.description: count, min, max, mean, median and sum of a numeric column of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset (grouping commas and currency are handled; non-numeric rows are excluded and counted).

tools.name: dataset_top
tools.description: The highest (or lowest) rows of the Roofing Quotes UK dataset by a numeric column — "which is the most/least X".

tools.name: dataset_provenance
tools.description: The source, the date it was computed, the licence and the citation for the Roofing Quotes UK dataset. Read this to attribute a figure correctly.

tools.name: entities_schema
tools.description: Which fields the Roofing Quotes UK register register carries and on how many entities, the regions and services, the identifier schemes, and how to cite it. Call this first.

tools.name: entity_lookup
tools.description: The Roofing Quotes UK register entry for a firm, by its register identifier (scheme + value, e.g. lei) or by the slug of its page. Exact match; returns the whole record with its page.

tools.name: entities_search
tools.description: Entities of Roofing Quotes UK register whose name, commercial name, website, address or authority contains the query, optionally within a region (id or name) and a service (slug or name). Up to 50 rows.

tools.name: entities_in
tools.description: The Roofing Quotes UK register entities in one region (a state or a jurisdiction, by id or name), optionally for one service, 50 a page.

tools.name: entities_export
tools.description: Every entity of Roofing Quotes UK register, 200 a page, with provenance. Needs an access key (Authorization: Bearer); export pages are metered per key per day. Without a key the answer says how to get one.

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Roofing Quotes UK: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms.

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Roofing Quotes UK enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Roofing Quotes UK — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent line.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "entities_export" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Every entity of Roofing Quotes UK register, 200 a page, with provenance. Needs an access key (Authorization: Bearer); export pages are metered per key per day. …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: entity_lookup, submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: entity_lookup, submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
